region.delhi.intro: Delhi on the Yamuna is the seat of the sultans and later the heart of the Mughal empire. Armies, taxes and poets from all over the Islamic world flow into it, while thousands of villages around it plough and pay their dues as they did under the rajas.
region.vijayanagara.intro: Vijayanagara, the City of Victory, is the capital of the great Hindu empire of the south, set among granite hills on the Tungabhadra. Temples, bazaars heaped with gems, festivals with a thousand elephants. In 1565 the city will be sacked, and life will move to the villages and towns of the region.
region.bengal.intro: Bengal is a land of great rivers, rice paddies and muslin finer than a spider web. The capitals Gaur and Pandua raise brick mosques, boats laden with goods glide along the channels, and every summer the monsoon decides whether the year will be a full one.
region.gujarat.intro: Gujarat lives by the sea: ships leave Cambay and Surat for Aden, Hormuz and Malacca. Jain and bania merchants count every coin, weavers dye cotton, and from 1411 a new capital, Ahmedabad, rises over the land.
